scenario_id.description: Evaluation case ID; null for ordinary user requests.

intent.description: Requested answer shape; do not create a day-by-day plan for a hotel-only request.

city.description: City as resolved from user text; null if missing. Keep database spelling in retrieval filters.

start.description: ISO 8601 calendar date YYYY-MM-DD; null when absent or unresolved.

end.description: ISO 8601 calendar date YYYY-MM-DD; null when absent or unresolved.

date_meaning.description: How to interpret start/end; never assume a hotel checkout from an inclusive event range.

amount_sar.description: Maximum or exclusive bound on the recorded hotel price; null if not provided.

operator.description: lt for under/below, lte for at most/up to. Do not silently change it.

trip_budget_sar.description: Total trip budget when given; cannot be verified from hotel prices alone.

hotel_guest_out_of_10.description: Hotel guest rating threshold on a 10-point scale.

restaurant_out_of_5.description: Restaurant average rating threshold on a 5-point scale.

activity_out_of_5.description: Entertainment rating threshold on a 5-point scale.

hotel_stars.description: Hotel star classification; separate from guest rating.

hotel_count.description: Requested number of hotels; zero when not requested.

restaurant_count.description: Requested number of dining venues; zero when not requested.

activity_count.description: Requested number of entertainment or attraction venues; zero when not requested.

event_count.description: Requested number of events; zero when not requested.

breakfast_included.description: True if explicitly required; null when unspecified; false if explicitly excluded.

free_cancellation.description: True if explicitly required; null when unspecified; false if explicitly excluded.

family_event.description: True if family admission explicitly required; null if unspecified.

requested_facts.description: Other explicit user questions such as opening hours or live availability.

interpretation_status.description: Parsing status, independent of database retrieval.

clarifying_questions.description: Questions needed before definitive recommendations; empty if ready.
